Provenance
==========

Origin: SYNTHETIC (hand-authored)
Date:   2026-05-21
Author: costa (B3 Phase 2 batch 1)

Reproduces the DOM contract HOST_MAIN_SELECTORS["stackoverflow.com"]
binds against:

  #mainbar  (full main column — fallback selector)
    #question  (preferred — the question body alone)
    #answer    (single accepted answer)
  #sidebar  (decoy — right rail with related questions, must NOT win)

Real captures from stackoverflow.com inline ~600 KB of vendor CSS;
synthetic HTML proves selector resolution without the file-size cost.
